causes.text: On September 28 2022, Biogen and Eisai announced that their Alzheimer's drug lecanemab significantly slowed cognitive decline in a pivotal trial. The breakthrough bolstered hopes for disease-modifying therapies and sent shares of Alzheimer-focused companies like Eli Lilly and Roche soaring 6-7 percent as investors speculated that other amyloid-targeting drugs might also succeed.

source_info.title: Alzheimer's drug trial breakthrough boost for Roche, Eli Lilly

effects.text: Just over a month later, on November 1 2022, Eli Lilly issued an annual profit forecast that fell short of analyst estimates. The company cited a stronger U.S. dollar and looming generic competition for its cancer drug Alimta as headwinds, which outweighed a solid quarterly performance and caused Lilly's shares to drop 2.6 percent.

source_info.title: Eli Lilly's dismal annual forecast overshadows quarterly beat

causal_reasoning_chain.description: The positive lecanemab results from Biogen and Eisai in late September 2022 renewed optimism about Alzheimer's therapies. Investors projected that companies with similar amyloid-targeting drugs, including Eli Lilly's donanemab, could also see breakthrough success, driving a rally in their stocks.

The enthusiasm raised expectations for Lilly to deliver strong financial performance and pipeline updates, pushing valuations higher. As valuations rose, the market became more sensitive to any negative surprises in subsequent earnings guidance.

On 2022-11-01, Lilly issued an annual profit outlook below Wall Street estimates, blaming a strong U.S. dollar and the arrival of generic competition for its blockbuster cancer drug Alimta. This guidance disappointed investors whose expectations had been inflated by the Alzheimer's optimism, leading to a 2.6% drop in Lilly's share price.

rationale: Biogen and Eisai's breakthrough raised the bar for Alzheimer's drug developers and lifted valuations across the sector. When Lilly's subsequent guidance fell short due to currency and generic headwinds, the contrast between heightened expectations and modest reality triggered a share decline.
counterfactual_analysis: Had the Alzheimer's breakthrough not occurred, investor expectations for Lilly may have been lower. The company's modest forecast could have been seen as routine rather than disappointing, possibly resulting in a smaller stock drop.

adversarial_confounders.text: Broader currency fluctuations and macroeconomic conditions during late 2022
adversarial_confounders.impact: Volatility in the U.S. dollar and global markets could have independently influenced Lilly's earnings outlook and stock movement.

details.commentary: After several quarters of outperformance and multiple expansion, investor expectations for Apple's earnings had risen substantially. When results merely met or modestly beat forecasts, some shareholders took profits, helping to cool the enthusiasm and bring the stock's valuation closer to underlying fundamentals.
